title: Dynamics of Topological Spin Structures and Photocarriers Visualized by Ultrafast Electron Microscopy
content: Ultrafast electron microscopy (UEM), which enables the direct observation of transient structures, morphologies, magnetic domains and carrier transport of functional materials in real time and space, has attracted increasing interest to the research community due to its powerful capability in the interdisciplines of physics, chemistry, material science, and biology [1-4].
